stem: A peer repeats the same task error after a clear demonstration. What should Technician II do next?
choices: Stop or correct the task as needed, verify the controlled instruction was understood, document the recurring execution problem when required, and escalate training or supervision needs through the defined channel
Ignore the error because coaching was already attempted
rationale: Technician II can coach and support correct execution but does not own formal discipline, staffing, or unilateral procedure changes.
